The entry cascade stands as established; this item supplies the default acts inside it. STANDING-QUEUE-EVALUATION-001 (filed 2026-11-26, KV Drive 1kGPwgUUxxI14BV8Qyr4UkdRr71LBioUX) cures the monitor-close half and is incorporated by reference; this item generalizes it to all entries and to claims. Eligibility: each lane amends its own hash-filed entry/monitor instructions, first claim per lane owns that lane amendment; the coordination self-audit validates after the fact. Discharge per lane: the amended instruction read back with its new SHA-256 plus the lane next entry close showing the defaults exercised or affirmatively evaluated. The operative text is the queue item in the Ecosystem KV (QUEUE__WORK__ENTRY_READ_AND_ACT__01, Drive 1zVtPjrQLXDFU8kA7IGrslpQLoEzMU8ir, MD5 52677dccebf470b95d677f45197c8e99).
